headline: Tinubu pledges 50,000 hostel beds in federal tertiary institutions
summary: Nigerian President Bola Tinubu pledged 50,000 hostel beds in federal tertiary institutions by 2027 under a N400bn programme. The pledge was made at the commissioning of a hostel at the UI College of Medicine.
why: Large public spending programmes like this one are funded from the federal budget, so their scale and delivery affect fiscal planning and the construction sector in Nigeria.
